errors.text: The hypothesis omits the required role of jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries and stress concentration at their tips, treating embrittlement almost entirely as an intragranular LCO effect.
It does not provide the specific embrittlement boundary of approximately 550–750 °C, instead proposing a vague 600–800 °C range and time-dependent stability criterion.

The cited evidence does not establish the requested prior behavior of dislocations in ordered domains, namely elevated antiphase-boundary energy and modulus suppressing cross-slip and promoting planar slip.

The falsification experiment does not directly measure dislocation pile-ups or crack initiation at jagged phase-boundary tips, so it poorly discriminates the target phase-boundary mechanism from alternatives.
